title: Café déjà vu — a resilient brief
subtitle: Unicode, deliberate wrapping, and native shapes

slides.title: Accents stay readable
slides.content: Écrire une phrase courte avec des caractères comme œ, à, ç, ñ, and punctuation — without losing editability.

bullet_points.title: Unicode text
bullet_points.description: Keep names and language-specific characters selectable.

bullet_points.title: Safe wrapping
bullet_points.description: Leave enough room for a viewer with different font metrics.

bullet_points.title: No truncation
bullet_points.description: Validate limits before rendering instead of hiding copy.

slides.title: Long copy is a rendering risk
slides.content: A deliberately longer sentence exercises the bounded content area and makes clipping visible in a viewer regression review before a release ships.

bullet_points.title: Review first
bullet_points.description: Inspect the outline before committing to the exported layout.

bullet_points.title: Keep hierarchy
bullet_points.description: Use a short title and put nuance in the description.

bullet_points.title: Report clearly
bullet_points.description: Name the viewer, platform, theme, and source fixture.

slides.title: A focused composition
slides.content: The focus layout reserves a narrow visual frame while keeping the narrative and three native bullet cards legible.

bullet_points.title: One frame
bullet_points.description: Use a strong visual anchor without embedding a screenshot.

bullet_points.title: Three points
bullet_points.description: Preserve the stable content contract for downstream tooling.

bullet_points.title: Editable output
bullet_points.description: Every text element remains a normal PowerPoint shape.
